title: Extending Rényi-Divergence Leakage Analysis to Decision Problems
summary: A Rényi-divergence leakage analysis is known for search problems, but extending it to decision problems with the same efficiency remains open.

formal_statement.body: A Rényi-divergence-based leakage analysis is currently valid only for search problems. The open problem is to extend this analysis to decision problems while retaining the same efficiency achieved for search problems.

scope.domain: Cryptographic side-channel analysis of leakage-enabled security games.
parameters: q, the number of leakage queries affecting the efficiency target
scope.unresolved_remainder: Extend the Rényi-divergence-based leakage analysis from search problems to decision problems while preserving the efficiency achieved for search problems.

citations.label: Unifying Leakage Models on a Rényi Day

progress.summary: The source explicitly limits the Rényi-divergence analysis to search problems and identifies matching efficiency for decision problems as an open question.
citation_labels: Thomas Prest et al., Unifying Leakage Models on a Rényi Day
